summary: eval-swarm.md declares azoth_effect: read but the command explicitly orchestrates Wave D (builder/planner Tasks that commit file changes). CLAUDE.md governance rule 7 mandates azoth_effect: mixed for any command that can trigger Write/Edit — 'never hide implementation behind read-only wording'.
evidence: eval-swarm.md frontmatter: azoth_effect: read. Wave D section: 'pass gap summaries to planner/builder Tasks, then re-run Wave C with new evaluators.' builder/planner Tasks write files. CLAUDE.md §8: 'If a prompt can trigger Write/Edit (build path), it must be clearly marked.' .claude/commands/auto.md and deliver-full.md are marked mixed for the same reason.
recommended_action: Change azoth_effect: read → azoth_effect: mixed in .claude/commands/eval-swarm.md. Sync the same change to .github/prompts/eval-swarm.prompt.md (mode: agent is set but no effect label exists there — consider adding an effect note in the description). Re-run azoth-deploy.py to propagate.

summary: Both Copilot adapter prompts contain hard cross-references to .claude/commands/eval.md and .claude/commands/eval-swarm.md. In a consumer repo that installs only the GitHub Copilot adapter (no .claude/ directory), those Read targets are dead references. Other deployed .github/prompts/ files have the same pattern but this PR adds two new occurrences.
evidence: .github/prompts/eval.prompt.md: 'see .claude/commands/eval.md § When /eval escalates'. eval-swarm.prompt.md: 'see .claude/commands/eval.md § When /eval escalates to swarm eval'. The root-azoth workshop has both directories, but public product consumers using copilot-only may not.
recommended_action: Add a prose note near the cross-references: 'If .claude/commands/ is not present, refer to the skill in .github/prompts/ or your platform equivalent.' Alternatively, anchor escalation trigger table text directly in the .github/prompts/ versions rather than deferring to .claude/ paths. Track against D35/D36 (extraction profiles for public product).

summary: E4 escalation trigger references 'Trust Contract file ceiling' without citing the numeric value (10 files/turn per TRUST_CONTRACT.md §1 Per-Turn Limits table). Agents applying the trigger check may apply it inconsistently if they have not read §1 recently.
evidence: eval.md E4: 'approaches or exceeds Trust Contract file ceiling'. TRUST_CONTRACT.md §1 table row: 'Files modified | 10 per turn'. The trigger is correct but the value is implicit, requiring agents to cross-reference.
recommended_action: Annotate E4 with the numeric anchor: e.g., 'approaches or exceeds Trust Contract file ceiling (10 files/turn — §1)'. Same annotation should propagate to .github/prompts/eval.prompt.md via azoth-deploy.py or manual sync.
